title: Paper swarm
description: Printed sheets tumble through a deep blue volume in a single instanced draw call.
useCase: An ambient field for an archive, publishing identity, or editorial transition.
interaction: Move the pointer for parallax; change or reverse the flow
reducedMotion: The volume holds one frame and pointer parallax stops.
limitations: Requires WebGL2; a static CSS paper composition appears if unavailable or the context is lost. 150 deterministic instances; the display-aware drawing buffer is capped at 3.6 million pixels. Remount to recover a lost context.
look: Saturated royal-blue field scattered with angled orange and pale-grey printed sheets showing dark headline blocks and text lines, plus a translucent slider bar.
motion: 150 printed sheets spin, roll and rise endlessly through a 3D volume at varied speeds; pointer movement eases the camera for parallax, and a slider speeds or reverses the flow.
adapt: Motion lives in `vertexSource`: per-sheet `angle`, `roll` and vertical drift all scale with `time`; `sheets` seeds 150 instance positions and `render` eases `cameraX`/`cameraY` toward the pointer. Restyle the printed sheets in `fragmentSource`; keep the static fallback.
